generatorProvenance.disclosure: Hashes identify the exact generator sources and lock file. The Git commit remains null until this repository has a reviewed commit.

limitations: One public recording and one selected unit do not support population generalization.
Behavioral covariates are observational; predictive fit is not causal evidence.
Scores compare one fixed split and should not be interpreted as benchmark rankings.
Displayed traces are deterministically decimated by five; metrics use all held-out rows.

basisExplorer.disclosure: These curves and design-matrix rows were evaluated with the installed NeMoS basis API. They form an isolated basis explorer and were not used to fit or score the frozen four-raw-feature GLM.

nemos.disclosure: Actually fit with NeMoS/JAX on the common standardized behavioral features and chronological training block. The held-out trace is a prediction demonstration, not an estimate of causal encoding.
nemos.label: NeMoS Poisson GLM
nemos.validationUse: reported only; estimator configuration is fixed in the script

pytorch.disclosure: Actually trained on CPU with deterministic PyTorch operations, three predeclared architectures, and the common chronological split. The main lane is selected only by validation deviance; the held-out scores are not used to choose an architecture.
pytorch.label: PyTorch validation-selected Poisson network
pytorch.selectionRule: Choose the lowest outer-validation mean Poisson deviance after candidate-specific early stopping; a tie favors fewer parameters, then lexical candidate id. Final-test metrics do not participate.
pytorch.validationUse: selected each early-stopping checkpoint and then the architecture by outer-validation Poisson deviance; final-test values were recorded only after that rule selected the main lane

baseline.configuration: One constant prediction equal to the mean next-bin count in outer training rows [0, 3600)
baseline.disclosure: This is a leakage-safe descriptive reference, not a tuned model. Its constant is computed from outer training targets only.
baseline.label: Training-mean intercept-only reference

folds.preprocessing: Mean and standard deviation fit on this fold's training rows only
Mean and standard deviation fit on this fold's training rows only
Mean and standard deviation fit on this fold's training rows only

crossValidation.selectionRule: Select the lowest mean training-only cross-validation deviance; an exact tie favors the larger alpha. Outer validation and final test results are not inputs to selection.
crossValidation.strategy: Three expanding-window chronological folds contained within outer training rows [0, 3600)

sklearn.disclosure: Actually fit with scikit-learn on the common chronological training block. Coefficients and held-out predictions are precomputed; no claim of biological generalization is made.
sklearn.label: scikit-learn PoissonRegressor
sklearn.validationUse: outer validation reported only; alpha selected by expanding-window cross-validation contained entirely within the training block

stan.disclosure: Actually sampled with CmdStan using explicit weakly informative priors. The posterior-mean held-out rate is shown for comparison; posterior diagnostics and the training subsample stride remain attached.
stan.label: Stan uncertainty lane

posteriorDrawSamples.disclosure: These are every fifth actual post-warmup draw from the fitted Stan chains, stored only to support an inspectable posterior distribution chart. Summary diagnostics use all draws.

posteriorPredictiveCheck.disclosure: These are predictive count intervals from actual posterior draws and deterministic Poisson simulations, not confidence intervals. They assess this fitted model on one held-out block and do not establish calibration beyond it.

stan.validationUse: reported only; posterior configuration is fixed in the script

features: trailing speed from current and prior positions (m/s)
task.metric: Mean Poisson deviance on all 1,499 held-out rows
task.researchQuestion: How well do current-bin x position, y position, trailing speed, and current t1c1 count predict t1c1 spike count in the next 100 ms bin?
task.validationUse: The frozen validation block selects PyTorch early stopping checkpoints and the predeclared PyTorch architecture. scikit-learn alpha is selected only by chronological folds inside training; NeMoS and Stan remain fixed and report validation without tuning on it.
